verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance automation platform, so built-in security awareness training is a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions training modules, assignment on hire, completion tracking, or training records as audit evidence. Policy acknowledgment automation and general evidence collection are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an operations lead, security awareness training is built in — assigned on hire, tracked to completion, and accepted as audit evidence
